fact: El Mouhassil was launched in the Sebkha municipal management system in April 2019 after a seven-week taxpayer census that found 10,564 taxpayers against 2,000 officially recognised, and by April 2020 eight other communes were installing it.
title: Sécurisation de la taxe communale : Le logiciel El Moussahil, symbole d une collaboration réussie avec la GIZ
